resolution.question: Will doctoral candidate Femi Adeyemi and his three committee members converge on a defense date inside the department's November window within the next ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all three committee members and Femi have agreed on a specific defense date within the department's November window before 2026-09-24T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
